snippet.title: God of War Laufey - Pre-Orders Open Now | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Pre Orders at https://www.playstation.com/games/god-of-war-laufey
Learn More at https://blog.playstation.com/2026/09/28/god-of-war-laufey-pre-orders-available-starting-september-29-editions-detailed/

Death was supposed to be the end, but for Laufey (Faye), warrior and wife to Kratos, a new adventure is just beginning.

Watch the full reveal and extended look at God of War Laufey’s gameplay here: https://youtu.be/HLMX2w3cwuE?si=7dZqcVr0tH1zPbl4

Coming February 16, 2027 to PlayStation 5.

Pre-Order Now!
